rows.text:
Initial 3 Villagers:
1st Vill and Pharoah goes out and builds a Dock, then to Food
2nd and 3rd Villagers go to wood and build a Lumber Camp
rows.note:
Priest scouts the map and builds Obelisks.
Dock auto-queues Fishing Ships.

rows.text: 2 Vill gather Food next to TC

rows.note:
Pharoah and Villager near Dock go to 2nd Fish location
and build 2nd Dock, after that:
Pharao goes back to empower TC
Vill becomes a builder: build Houses

At 150 Gold build a Temple with 2 of the Gold Vill, 
then back to Gold

rows.text:
Vill transition:
3 Food vill to Gold
3 Food vill to Wood
rows.note:
Build a Monument
Build a Granary

rows.text: Continue balancing your economy with reaching Heroic in mind.
rows.note:
Continue building Docks and Fishing Ships on available fish sites.
Build an Armory and Market.
Build a 2nd Monument.
Optional: Build Barracks with Spearmen+Anubite to scout the map and raid.
